html:
Perks › Epic

Pip Shuffle

Epic perk · Active ability

Once per hand, drag any number of pips across a bone's divider. Values stay within 0–6. The shuffled bone becomes public and must be played this turn.

In-game card text

How it works

Once per hand, move any number of pips across a bone's divider, keeping the total the same and every half between 0 and 6. A 1-5 could become 0-6, 2-4 or 3-3.

  • As with Pip Shift, you can only confirm a result that can be played now, the bone becomes public, and you must play it this turn.
  • More copies do not add uses; it stays once per hand.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeActive ability
UsesOne use per hand no matter how many copies you hold.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 900 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Rare perks.
